Topics covered in this PDF

MPSE-013 (Australian Foreign Policy) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Theoretical frameworks of Australian foreign policy, foreign policy making actors, geo-economics and security, India-Australia relations, the Pacific Islands Forum and ASEAN
  • Globalisation and trade, China, Taiwan and human rights, immigration and refugee policy, environmental commitments, ANZUS

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

  • The PDF carries no cover question-paper preview, so the marks scheme and word limits are not printed in it. The course title is taken from the existing Hindi page for this code and is not printed in the PDF. Ten questions are printed with their answers.
